owner_approval: Olesia (human-in-the-loop, required before any download/implementation step)
purpose: Tracks what skills/knowledge are missing or partial, and defines the pipeline Hermes follows to find, safety-check, and (only after approval) acquire them from GitHub.
companion_file: hermes-operating-instructions.json (contains the detailed safety-scan, model-routing, Kanban, and substitution rules referenced below by name — this file does not duplicate them).

safety_tool.name: Microsoft Application Inspector
safety_tool.what_it_does: Static source-code analyzer that scans an open-source repo BEFORE you use it and reports what the code actually does: crypto usage, network calls, shell/OS operations, cloud API calls, and other risk signals.
safety_tool.decision_rule: If flagged with unexplained network calls, shell execution, or obfuscated code, STOP and ask Olesia before proceeding.

acquisition_pipeline.name: Detect gap
acquisition_pipeline.action: Hermes compares current project requirements against Olesia's known skill/tool inventory (see skill_gap_assessment below) and flags anything marked 'missing' or 'partial' that blocks the current task.

acquisition_pipeline.name: Substitution check
acquisition_pipeline.action: Apply hermes-operating-instructions.json -> step_0_substitution_rule before searching GitHub: prefer already-in-use tools, then free/open-source, then new paid only with justification.

acquisition_pipeline.name: Search GitHub
acquisition_pipeline.action: If still needed, search GitHub for a repo/library that fills the specific gap.

acquisition_pipeline.name: Shortlist
acquisition_pipeline.action: Propose 1-3 candidate repos with: stars, last commit date, license, 1-line description. Present to Olesia before downloading anything.

acquisition_pipeline.name: MANDATORY safety scan
acquisition_pipeline.action: Run Microsoft Application Inspector against the shortlisted repo (shallow clone to a throwaway temp folder) before any real download.

acquisition_pipeline.name: Human review of scan
acquisition_pipeline.action: Summarize findings in plain language. Olesia approves or rejects before proceeding.

acquisition_pipeline.name: Download
acquisition_pipeline.action: Only after approval: clone/download the repo into the correct project folder.

acquisition_pipeline.name: Implement
acquisition_pipeline.action: Integrate the code, run it in an isolated/test branch first, never directly on production or the main branch.

acquisition_pipeline.name: Log
acquisition_pipeline.action: Log the acquired skill/tool in Obsidian (Daily Log) and update the skill_gap_assessment status from 'missing' to 'have'.
